summary: Completed E2E testing of RolliSuite ERP - 7 core modules (Dashboard, Customers, Estimates, Jobs, Sales Orders, Watches, Parts). Backend: 18/18 tests passed. Frontend: All modules functional after fixing auth token bug in useWatches.ts and useParts.ts hooks.

minor.issue: Returns only 1 customer instead of 3 - possible pagination/filter issue (low priority as mentioned in requirements)

integration_issues.issue: FIXED - Auth token key mismatch: hooks used 'token' instead of 'auth_token'

action_items: LOW PRIORITY: Investigate Customers API pagination - only showing 1 of 3 customers in UI
critical_code_review_comments: useWatches.ts and useParts.ts had duplicate axios instances with wrong token key - should use shared api.ts instead
Consider consolidating all API hooks to use the shared api.ts instance to avoid token key mismatches
seed_data_creation: Using existing seed data: 3 customers, 4 watches, 3 parts, 3 estimates, 3 jobs, 2 sales orders
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 modules tested and working. Auth token bug fixed in useWatches.ts and useParts.ts. Backend runs on port 8001 (Fastify), Frontend on port 3000 (Vite). This is a custom monorepo stack, not the default Emergent stack. Services must be started manually from /app/apps/rollisuite-api and /app/apps/rollisuite-web directories.

modules_tested.dashboard: Working - shows Active Jobs (3), Pending Estimates (2), Open Sales Orders (2), Daily Hit List
modules_tested.customers: Working - list, detail, create form functional. Shows 1 customer (pagination issue)
modules_tested.estimates: Working - shows 3 estimates with statuses (Draft, Sent, Approved)
modules_tested.jobs: Working - shows 3 jobs with priority indicators (Urgent, High, Normal)
modules_tested.watches: Working - shows 4 watches after auth fix
modules_tested.parts: Working - shows 3 parts with stock levels after auth fix
